name.ja: <ruby>絶火の祆威<rt>ウィスプラート・マギストス</rt></ruby>

text.en: Target 1 "Magistus" or Spellcaster monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip that opponent's face-up monster to your monster as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster in your GY; shuffle both it and this card into the Deck. You can only use 1 "Wisprath Magistus" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
